questions.example: The shipment left the factory yesterday.
questions.exampleZh: 這批貨昨天已經離開工廠了。

questions.example: Our supplier sent us a new price list.
questions.exampleZh: 我們的供應商寄給我們新的價目表。

questions.example: What is the unit price if we order 500 pieces?
questions.exampleZh: 如果我們訂 500 個，單價是多少？

questions.example: I have attached the purchase order for your confirmation.
questions.exampleZh: 我已附上採購單，請您確認。

questions.example: The goods are still at customs, so delivery will be late.
questions.exampleZh: 貨物還在海關，所以交貨會延遲。

questions.example: Our payment terms are 30 days after the invoice date.
questions.exampleZh: 我們的付款條件是發票日後 30 天。

questions.example: Could you send us a sample before we place the order?
questions.exampleZh: 我們下訂單前，你可以先寄樣品給我們嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：Email 結尾，想說「期待您的回覆」，最自然的說法是？
options: I look forward to hearing from you.
I am look forward to hear you.
I will forward to hear from you.
questions.example: Thank you for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.
questions.exampleZh: 謝謝您的協助，期待您的回覆。

questions.prompt: 情境：想請廠商告訴你出貨最新狀況，最自然的說法是？
options: You must tell me the status now.
Could you give me an update on the shipment?
What is happen to the shipment?
questions.example: Hi Tom, could you give me an update on the shipment?
questions.exampleZh: Tom 你好，可以告訴我出貨的最新狀況嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：主管問你問題，你需要確認後再回覆，最自然的說法是？
options: Let me check and get back to you.
I don't know, ask other people.
questions.example: Good question. Let me check and get back to you this afternoon.
questions.exampleZh: 好問題，我確認一下，今天下午回覆你。
